summary: Sort numeric values with an explicit comparison rule.
documentation: sort rearranges the array in place. Its comparator returns a negative value when a should come first, a positive value when b should come first, and zero when they compare equally.
inputs: An array and an optional comparator.
caution: Without a comparator, values are compared as strings. Copy the array first when the original should remain unchanged.
scenarios: Order quoted prices numerically before presenting options.
Arrange appointment durations for capacity planning.
Sort stock counts before reviewing low quantities.
title: Order the estimate amounts
problem: Given an array of integer amounts in cents, return the amounts in ascending numeric order. Keep duplicates and allow negative credits.
goal: Use Array.sort() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Copy with [...value], then use a numeric comparator.
